headline: Historian on whether deal to end Ukraine war can be made at G7 summit
context: NPR's A Martinez speaks with Sergey Radchenko of Johns Hopkins University about the Ukraine war and whether progress toward a diplomatic solution can be made at the G7 summit in France.
